instruction: Read the waiting interval between the eye drops from the caregiver note on the Desktop, start a timer for that amount of time on vclock.com, and leave it running where it can be seen.
source: Local caregiver note prepared for the task
gt_steps: Set the timer duration to `5 minutes`.

parameters.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop\caregiver_note.txt') -Value 'Caregiver note: Please give the next eye drop after 5 minutes.'"
